queries.result: The native-language discovery route was attempted against official Telangana land-record and district channels; the public Bhu Bharati GIS route exposed district/division/mandal/village and map parcel-information controls, but no anonymous Karimnagar parcel response with safe native identity and geometry was obtained.

officialSources.observation: Official Karimnagar district portal lists the district Survey & Land Records department, establishing a local survey/land-record custodian.

Official Telangana Bhu Bharati GIS page describes map-based parcel information and presents district, division, mandal and village selectors; the current page did not yield a usable anonymous feature response in this attempt.
Official Telangana Remote Sensing Applications Centre Web GIS catalogue lists Bhubharathi and Bhunaksha among Survey of Lands services.

Official TGRAC ArcGIS REST metadata identifies a polygon Feature Layer named Cadastral Parcels, with a projected Lambert Conformal Conic CRS and fields including OBJECTID, Parcel_num, and administrative labels. The metadata extent and service naming do not by themselves establish Karimnagar citywide coverage.
